headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a thrilling 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0 behind Christian Walker's 3-hit performance, including two home runs and three RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, with Patrick Corbin leading the Blue Jays to victory.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain with the Arizona Diamondbacks. Carter Baumler has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right intercostal strain for the Texas Rangers. Jordan Hicks has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 21 with a right lat strain for the Chicago White Sox.

The Philadelphia Phillies have made a roster move, trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Pierce Johnson earning the win. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-hit performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win at home. Patrick Corbin led the Blue Jays to victory with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
